decidedBy: the project owner, 2026-10-12: a name the Hebrew marks and nothing reads is held as a people or a place, as the standard references treat it (BHSA's own marking, Strong's and Brown-Driver-Briggs's entries, the OpenBible gazetteer); gods, months and Ezekiel's Oholah and Oholibah are left; each word read against its verse by claude-opus-5-5
policy: Each word BHSA marks as a name, or analyses as a gentilic, that no record answered is given the people or the place the references make it: the record the gazetteer or the lexicon already holds, or one written here from the verse. These are the places whose word every translation we hold reads as a common noun — a wood, villages, a palace, horns, an army, white wool, secretly — so the name stays on the Hebrew word and is not carried to theirs.
source: Essenthos, the place names the Hebrew marks and the translations read as common words, each read against its verse by claude-opus-5-5 on the project owner's ruling of 2026-10-12
